purpose: Describe a sensory impression that is perceived.
keywords: Sound / smell / taste noun + がする.
A lovely smell is coming from the kitchen.
There was a strange sound outside.
formation: Sound / smell / taste noun + がする.
restrictions: Use an appropriate sensory noun; this is not a general replacement for sensing every state.
mistake: 音がする describes hearing a sound, not deliberately making it.
